\newcommand{\FigProfileCaption}{Evaluation protocol: held-out speed bands (PRIMARY protocol). Three views of each sensor, ordered by marginal permutation importance. LEFT: the drop in inner-validation macro-F1 when all 18 features of that sensor are permuted together, mean and standard deviation over the 10 splits; this is a MARGINAL contribution, measured with every other sensor present. CENTRE: the macro-F1 that sensor reaches on its own. RIGHT: its mean absolute Spearman correlation to the other six, over all 18 matched features. Reading the panels together separates the two cases a marginal measure cannot: \texttt{ob\_tan} has the lowest marginal contribution of the set (0.0022) yet is the third best single sensor (0.8493), so its low score reflects redundancy rather than an absence of information. The 10 splits come from 2 repeats of 5-fold cross-validation over the same recordings and are therefore not mutually independent.}
